description: This file defines the ChartHelper class which provides static methods for creating 3D surface plots, configuring surface models, and UI components related to chart visualization in a Java Swing application.

classes.name: ChartHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for creating and configuring 3D surface charts and related UI components.

methods.name: create3DControl
methods.description: Creates a JPanel containing a 3D surface plot with controls for saving the image and adjusting RPM and Y values.

methods.name: createDefaultSurfaceModel
methods.description: Overloaded methods to create a DefaultSurfaceModel for XYData, with optional secondary data and range parameters.

methods.name: setYRange
methods.description: Sets the Y-axis range of a DefaultSurfaceModel.
